single_user_long_prompt_gate.note: Fixed reference gate; does not establish quality at every context length.

interpretation: The single-user long-prompt gate passed for all three recorded arms.
At the tested multi-user cells, Tern-labelled arms were slower than vLLM FP8.
The 8-bit KV option held all requested tokens in the 128-user and 4096-token cells but was slower than the BF16 KV arm.
No multi-user quality gate was recorded.
This experiment does not establish that a later long-context issue was fixed.
